open_points.subject: ProgressPhoto binary read
open_points.text: “unknown, cross-project or hidden read is answered the same way” conflicts with “a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as an explicit storage-unavailable error” when a hidden or cross-project photo also has missing, oversize or unlisted stored content
open_points.question: When a photo read is unauthorized or concealed and its stored content is also undeliverable, does the caller receive the indistinguishable concealed response or the explicit storage-unavailable error?
options: Authorization and visibility concealment takes precedence, so storage is not examined or disclosed
Undeliverable photo content produces the explicit storage-unavailable error even when the photo is hidden or cross-project
open_points.default_guess: Apply authorization and visibility concealment first; emit storage-unavailable only for an otherwise authorized, visible photo.

witness.initial: Viewer V has an active session and grant to active project P. P contains hidden ProgressPhoto H whose file_ref points to missing stored content.
events: Viewer V requests H's binary by photo_id.
outcomes: Because H is hidden, the response is indistinguishable from an unknown or cross-project photo.
Because H's stored content cannot be delivered, the response is an explicit storage-unavailable error.
